headline: MOCK: Candidate shows intermediate in-vitro potency against EGFR; no clinical or safety evidence identified.

sections.summary: In comparable binding assays the candidate ranks 3rd of 4 compounds by median pChEMBL.

claims.text: In a shared kinase assay, the candidate (pChEMBL 7.6) was less potent than Mock Approved Drug A (8.2).

sections.summary: No cell-based or in-vivo results were retrieved.
No human trials of the candidate were found. The indication has completed Phase 3 trials of approved comparators.

claims.text: Mock Approved Drug A has a completed Phase 3 trial with posted results.

sections.summary: Only computed drug-likeness properties are available; no measured toxicity data.

claims.text: The candidate has 0 Lipinski rule-of-5 violations (computed).

openQuestions: Is the candidate selective for EGFR over related kinases?
Does in-vitro potency translate to cell-based activity?
nextSteps: Run cell-based assays in EGFR-dependent cell lines.
Obtain selectivity panel and early toxicity data before further comparison.
